hooks.name: SlopSeal: block agent install commands
hooks.description: Before the agent runs a shell command, runs the slopseal.hooks.on_install module with the hook payload on stdin. The module reads tool_input.command and exits 2 when the command installs packages (pip, npm, uv, poetry, conda, and other package managers, including through sudo, env, bash -c, and chained commands). The agent must verify the package with the slopseal MCP tool instead. Fails closed: if slopseal cannot run (exit code other than 0 or 2), the wrapper prints an install hint and blocks the command with exit 2. Installs the user runs go through the SlopSeal PATH shim, which verifies each package.

action.command: sh -c '"$1" -m slopseal.hooks.on_install; rc=$?; if [ $rc -ne 0 ] && [ $rc -ne 2 ]; then echo "BLOCKED: SlopSeal is not installed for \"$1\". Install it into that Python with: \"$1\" -m pip install git+https://github.com/mazi3012/SlopSeal.git" >&2; exit 2; else exit $rc; fi' sh python3
